title: Mario Tennis Fever
description: Mario Tennis returns on Nintendo Switch 2 with 38 playable characters, 30 Fever Rackets, Tournament, Trial Towers, Mix It Up, Adventure, Swing Mode, ranked online play, amiibo support and GameShare. Fever Shots give each racket a distinct court-changing effect.

gameplayPillars.title: Fever Rackets
gameplayPillars.description: Build the Fever Gauge and trigger racket-specific Fever Shots that freeze, shrink, shock, duplicate or otherwise disrupt opponents.

gameplayPillars.title: Pure tennis foundation
gameplayPillars.description: Topspin, slice, lob, movement, positioning and shot timing remain central underneath the Mario powers.

gameplayPillars.title: Many ways to compete
gameplayPillars.description: Play Tournament, Trial Towers, Mix It Up, Adventure, Swing Mode, Free Play, ranked online and GameShare sessions.

worldSummary: The Mushroom Kingdom hosts a huge tennis tournament across themed courts. Adventure mode sends Baby Mario and the transformed cast through a light story journey to regain their tennis abilities, while Tournament, Trial Towers and online play provide the long-term competitive structure.

storyChapters.title: Mushroom Kingdom tournament
storyChapters.body: Mario and friends enter a new high-energy tennis tournament.

storyChapters.title: Adventure transformation
storyChapters.body: The cast is transformed into babies and must relearn tennis while overcoming monsters and challenges.

storyChapters.title: Competitive mastery
storyChapters.body: Unlock characters, courts and Fever Rackets and take custom combinations into online or local matches.

faq.a: Nintendo advertises 38 playable characters, the largest roster in Mario Tennis history.

faq.q: How many Fever Rackets are there?
faq.a: The base feature set includes 30 Fever Rackets, with additional content such as the Black Hole Racket added through a free update.
Yes, the game targets 60 fps in both handheld and docked play according to multiple reviews and performance tests.

verdictSummary: The strongest modern Mario Tennis entry for pure on-court play: fast, readable and deep enough for long-term multiplayer, although Adventure mode remains comparatively short.
verdictPros: Excellent core tennis and Fever Racket system
Large roster and strong multiplayer suite
verdictCons: Special rackets can create balance frustrations
Resolution can be reconstructed rather than native 4K

reviews.quote: Praised the core tennis, Fever mechanics and multiplayer longevity.
Strong core tennis but criticized story content and balance.
